root_cause: Powerhouse could calculate verified value and company economics, but realized value was not canonically attributable to the PH-Pxxx problem that triggered the work. This prevented problem precision, solved-problem measurement and realized-value learning from sharing one lineage.
prevention_rule: Material realized value may only appear as Verified Value Created when execution, verification and evidence are present; it must preserve a canonical PH-Pxxx when one exists. Local/non-canonical problem identifiers must not create a second value taxonomy.

invariants: only executed verified value with evidence is counted
verified value preserves canonical PH-Pxxx problem lineage when available
local problem ids do not create parallel verified-value groups
company cockpit exposes Verified Value Created from runtime truth
